about: English specs and build status of the vanilla-batch rows, in the same format as docs/build-specs.json.

parts.spec: School set to Universal (0) with specialist exclusions cleared on the spell and its scrolls (including SCRL6D.ITM) so all specialist mages can learn and cast it; spell and scroll descriptions list the Baldur's Gate, Siege of Dragonspear, Shadows of Amn, and Throne of Bhaal familiars.

Each game keeps its own campaign familiar summoning (including EET's chapter-switched K#FAMSUM/K#FAMKIL), and all 24 campaign familiar CREs have their Hit Points pinned to 12 (9 for FAMIMP_) in Baldur's Gate and Siege of Dragonspear, 24 (18 for FAMIMP) in Shadows of Amn, and 48 in Throne of Bhaal.

Lasts 3 rounds + 1 round per caster level (4 to 23 rounds via projectiles cbmgr01..cbmgr20), switches its save from vs. spell to vs. breath (keeping the +2 bonus), and makes flying, incorporeal and dragon creatures immune by race (WYVERN, BEHOLDER, MEPHIT, SPECTRE, WRAITH, SHADOW, MIST, DRAGON); description updated.

Spell Revisions' Obscuring Mist replacement is dropped; Blindness stays as Blindness with its duration shortened from 2 hours to 1 round per 2 caster levels (minimum 2 rounds at levels 1-5, 3 rounds at 6-7, 4 rounds at 8-9, maximum 5 rounds at 10+); description updated.
Refreshes itself via leading opcode 321 and does not stack with Mirror Image (SPWI212, SPWI298).

Strength of One no longer lowers a party member's higher Strength (> 18 or 18/75+): the Strength and portrait icon payload moves to SPPR312A.SPL cast via opcode 146 (p2=1), guarded by two opcode 318 checks on SPLPROT rows for STR (stat 36) > 18 and STREXTRA (stat 37) >= 75; description updated.

Imposes -2 to all saving throws and THAC0 as a Curse bonus type (non-stacking with Doom and Curse via cbmagic_bonus.tpa and M_CBMBON.lua) on good targets who fail their save, and shows the Cursed portrait icon (row 35) instead of Aid (row 208).
Later: revisit whether neutral targets should also be affected in some form.

Wizard Conjure Fire/Air/Earth Elemental scale their 12/16/24 HD chances from 64/35/1 at level 12 to 60/35/5 at level 16 and 56/35/9 at level 20+ using probability windows [0, c12-1], [c12, c12+c16-1], [c12+c16, 100]. Druid Conjure Fire/Air/Earth Elemental scale from 64/35/1 at level 11 (61/37/2 at level 12, 52/42/6 at level 15) to 37/51/12 at level 20+, with size-by-HD creature names across all summoned elementals.

Barkskin, Flame Blade, Shillelagh, Regeneration, Animal Summoning I-III (SPPR402, SPPR501, SPPR602) and Conjure Animals (SPPR604) are restricted to druids and rangers, while Defensive Harmony (SPPR406) and Lesser Restoration (SPPR417) are restricted to clerics and paladins via the priest class flags at SPL offset 0x20.

Casting times reduced: Bless (9 to 5), Flame Strike (8 to 5), Heal (9 to 6), Blade Barrier (9 to 6), Bolt of Glory (9 to 6), Magic Resistance (9 to 5), Righteous Magic (9 to 5), True Seeing / True Sight (8 to 6 on SPPR505 and SPWI609), Glyph of Warding (9 to 5), Invisibility Purge (8 to 3), Strength (9 to 5) and Fire Seeds (9 to 6).
